neighbours.label: connective (' before', ' because', ',') leading into a clause or phrase about a seasonal or cyclical event in nature (plants turning, frosts, an orbit, nocturnal habits)
fire: The pasture is ideal for cattle in late spring and early summer before the grasses dry out and turn yellow.
The orchard should be sprayed in early autumn before the leaves begin to drop.
The planet is brightest at dusk, because when its orbit carries it nearer the Earth it reflects more light.
The moths are difficult to count because of their nocturnal flights, the buried cocoons of the pupae, and the thick undergrowth.
The reeds are cut for thatch in late winter before new shoots emerge from the mud.
The clover is tender for grazing sheep in the spring and fall before stems grow woody.
The comet fades in June, because when its path swings away from the Sun the ice stops evaporating.
The beetles are rarely seen because of their nighttime activity, the underground burrows of the grubs, and the scarcity of predators.
quiet: The café is ideal for students on weekday mornings before the office workers come in.
The contract should be signed in early autumn before the board meets again.
The singer is most popular in Japan, because when her label promoted the album it sold out.
The files are difficult to audit because of their odd formats, the missing pages of the ledgers, and the poor handwriting.
The tickets are sold at a discount in late winter before prices go up.
The gym is quiet for training on Mondays and Fridays before classes start.
The stock fell in June, because when the firm cut its forecast investors lost faith.
The suspects are rarely seen because of their careful habits, the hidden rooms of the house, and the lack of witnesses.

notes: Card: ',' x5, ' because' x3, ' before', ' of' in texts on the moon's phases, a planet's orbit, grass palatable 'in early spring and fall before plants turn', nocturnal larvae, a menstrual cycle. Probes were weak: 'before plants turn brown' 0.35, 'because of their nocturnal behavior, the hidden nests' 0.29, 'before the first frosts' 0.27, 'because when the Earth tilts' 0.23; the same connectives in non-nature sentences 0.03; dated moon and orbit sentences 0.03-0.06. The fire sentences sit near the 0.20 bar, so this may well fail.
